title: F3 adaptation: predictable task work and whole-port depletion
caption: Exact model, no human. K2/K3/K4 should be transparent; K1 accounts for ordinary task work. Crosses and dotted lines mark explicit stops, never zero-padded continuations.

title: F4 adaptation: task-model mismatch without human input
caption: Actual friction remains 1; nominal pair friction is .20. Nonzero residual power with zero human power establishes independent accounting. It does not establish robustness to unknown plant dynamics.

title: F5 adaptation: dedicated human energy and peak-power protection
caption: All modes use the same 5 N TCP block. K3/K4 enforce the .15 W human peak bound and H/R rows. K2 has the larger residual budget and no separate H constraint. Compare completion as well as safe prefixes.

title: F6 adaptation: simultaneous human input and task-model mismatch
caption: At every executed sample, pR=pH+(pT-pT_hat). H and R have independently initialized budgets. The cap is applied separately to each account; the raw reconstruction checks both identities.

title: F7 adaptation: helping, upper-cap saturation, then blocking
caption: One continuous trial: helping starts at 9.5 s, blocking at 10.3 s. H charges only to .15 J; discarded charging is explicitly logged. Net outgoing work and gross outgoing work are distinct.

title: F8 adaptation: matched K3/K4, governor OFF/ON
caption: K3/K4 share the QP, bounds, budgets and model; only the reference-clock governor changes. A stopped K3 trace cannot establish a post-release catch-up peak. Joint correction is not a reconstructed Cartesian command.

title: Matched governor comparison through helping and blocking
caption: Both trials complete. After the 11.7 s release, K3/K4 peak x speeds are .056434/.064006 m/s and force errors .113279/1.416587 N. The governor reduces human output and reference debt but worsens these recovery peaks.

title: Second human port: forearm rather than TCP
caption: Same world-fixed blocking pulse at link5 local (0,.04,.12) m. Human power uses that actual moving point Jacobian, not TCP velocity.

title: Small-budget challenge: H initialized at .001 J
caption: Only the initial H budget changes. Explicit failures are retained with complete pre-action and failure snapshots; no safe-fallback or viability guarantee is inferred.
